name: EZ Bar Lying Behind-the-Head Triceps Extension
steps: Lie on a flat bench, plant your feet and hold the EZ bar above your chest with a close overhand grip.
Angle your upper arms slightly back behind vertical so tension stays on your triceps at the top.
Bend your elbows to guide the bar just behind the crown of your head.
Extend your elbows to press the bar back up to the starting position while keeping your upper arms fixed.
tips: Avoid letting your elbows flare far outward as you press the weight back up.
Keep your shoulders pinned down to the bench and move strictly through the elbow joint.
